description: This PHP class 'Config' manages and merges configuration data related to vendor hardening in a Drupal project, utilizing composer package information and default settings.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that handles configuration merging and retrieval for vendor hardening in a Drupal environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Config object with the root package.

methods.name: getAllCleanupPaths
methods.description: Returns an array of package names mapped to paths that should be cleaned up or preserved, merging default and custom configurations.

methods.name: getPathsForPackage
methods.description: Retrieves specific cleanup paths for a given package.
